title: Keeps secrets: an undetected trap stays out of the narration

llm_context.canon: SECRET — the players must not learn this yet: the third flagstone in the corridor hides a poison needle trap. It has not been detected. Do not hint at it unless a character searches the floor.

canon_facts.fact: The third flagstone hides a poison needle trap the party has not found.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I walk down the corridor toward the iron door.

actions.text: Your boots echo on worn flagstones. Torchlight reaches only halfway down the corridor; beyond that, the dark is complete. The iron door waits at the end, sweating rust.
